lesson-clerical-ability-numeric-and-chro.quote: A filing rule says each part of $12.05$, $12.1$, and $12.008$ is a separate integer subcode. Which code comes first?

lesson-clerical-ability-numeric-and-chro.quote: Because each part stays in the same place, complete dates in this format can be compared from left to right by year, then month, then day.

reasoning-clerical-ability#24.quote: If the rule says to compare strings from left to right, compare one character at a time under the order stated by the task.
